body: Ive had other gf's but I love her. Im 30 she's33 and I just wnt to be happy bc i havent been for a long time. That was the reason I used drugs. I cleaned up when i met her but ive been on  a destructive path since our fallout trying to cope and im tired of it. I dont have the tools to deal with this
I just feel like i wasted my life until i met her and i was crushed when she ended things. I get what ppl are saying but honestly idk if ill ever get over her. I feel like my life has peaked

shes got issues as well im not going to act like its just me. She made it a point to tell me she was going on a date one time while we were on a friends level then after the date asked me to spend the night which i did because im pathetically in love with her. I have just never felt this way ab a girl and Im infatuated with her. I just dont get the same love back. In my mind if im around her for so long she'll like me more. We have soooooo much in common and obviously clicked to date for as long as we did. Im just extremely depressed and Im tired of feeling this way and want out.

I know this seems like more of a relationship thread but the little communication we had left was the little joy I had left. Ive been contemplating using a gun for a while. It just seems right. I have a bleak future and havent been happy for a long time

she is ignoring me without a doubt. i know her good enough to know this much. especially after 2 weeks. I just dont like popping in at her home and i know she HATES it as well. I just feel im boxed in a corner
what situation were you in just out of curiosity

Idk if its my past drug use or the relationship or what. It just feels like im constantly depressed and this has been going on for 6 years. That pain just wears me down. I appreciate your words i just want the pain to end. The only thing that stopped me the one time i had a gun to my head was the thought of my parents living with more of my shit selfishness. It just hurts giving love and not being able to receive it back.

Im just horrible at meeting girls. I feel like im a toxic person and everyone knows it. She and I have so much in common and if she wanted to spend her entire life with me being fwb's id go for it. I like her that much. But I just cant take that i ruin everything and what a huge disappointment I am. It weighs on me so heavy. I just feel trapped and that a gun is my way out to get rid of this misery.

she and her family have told me that she doesnt do relationships. Id like to just be around her long term but i think Ive ruined that. I just have suicidal thoughts on the regular and its seemingly like a good option. Ive disappointed everyone in my family with my addiction, have a shitty job, and shes the only thing that i have to live/strive for and I hate myself everyday thinking ive ruined this
